---
title: position-dodge
subtitle: "Dodge position adjustment: place grouped bars side by side."
category: Positions
since: 0.1.0
engine: markdown
---


Typically set on a layer as `position: "dodge"` rather than constructed
directly; the constructor exists for symmetry with the other positions.

## Usage

```typst
position-dodge(
  width: 0.9,
)
```


## Parameters

| Parameter | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `width` | `0.9` | Total width reserved for the dodged group, as a fraction of the category width. |

## Returns

Position dictionary with `name: "dodge"`, consumed by [`plot`](../core/plot.qmd).

## Examples

```{typst}
//| output-filename: "/assets/typst-render/position-dodge-1.svg"
//| width: 10cm
//| height: 6cm
#let d = (
  (q: "Q1", grp: "a", y: 3),
  (q: "Q1", grp: "b", y: 5),
  (q: "Q2", grp: "a", y: 4),
  (q: "Q2", grp: "b", y: 2),
)
#plot(
  data: d,
  mapping: aes(x: "q", y: "y", fill: "grp"),
  layers: (geom-col(position: "dodge"),),
)
```

## See also

[`position-stack`](position-stack.qmd), [`position-fill`](position-fill.qmd), [`position-identity`](position-identity.qmd).
